module: Executes the asynchronous commands sent to the game by the "beamng:v1/<command>/<data>" protocol scheme (browser link, -command command-line argument, pipe channel). Commands received before the interface is ready are queued then replayed on onUiReady. On the first update, reads the startup arguments (-command beamng:...).
notes: The text is decoded (%XX) then split on '/' into at most 3 parts: version, command, data (the '/' in the data are kept).

v1 commands handled: showMod, subscriptionMod, downloadMod (core_repository), updateZipMod (core_modmanager), openMap (core_loadMapCmd), loadSnapshot (core_snapshot), tech_utils/<function> (calls extensions.tech_utils[function]()), core_input_actions/<function>/<args...> (calls extensions.core_input_actions[function](args)), openWorkbench and runRepro (guarded by core_reproGuard.isCommandAllowed, executed via executeShell, absent from shipping builds).
Commands without a version test: startToolchainServer (loads networking_editorToolchain), startWorkbenchServer, startDebugServer, stopDebugServer, attachDebugger, detachDebugger.
When isStartingArg is true (instance launched only to process the command), openWorkbench and runRepro quit the game (shutdown(0)) after use or on failure.
tech_utils and core_input_actions allow calling an extension function by name from a link: keep this in mind for security.
Point to note: M.onExtensionLoaded is `nop` (field marked "undefined" by the extraction, presumably an empty global engine function; inferred from code).

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Empty function (nop): the extension does nothing on load.

onSchemeCommand.desc: Processes a "version/command/data" scheme command (without the "beamng:" prefix). Queues if the UI is not ready. Unknown or malformed commands are logged as errors.

isStartingArg.desc: true if the command comes from the game's startup arguments

onUiReady.desc: Hook: the interface is ready; runs the queued commands.

onFirstUpdate.desc: Hook: on the first update, looks for "-command beamng:..." in Engine.getStartingArgs() and executes it (ignored if the extension was reloaded).

onSerialize.desc: Hook: returns {ignoreStartupCmd = true} so that the GE reload does not replay the startup command.
